categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and adds unit test debugging utilities in src/test/util/common.{h,cpp} across 15 test suites.
categories.rationale: Improves unit test failure diagnostics by providing `operator<<` overloads for types like `FeeFrac`, `CScript`, and `CAddress` so Boost can print mismatched values. This improves debuggability and supports test framework migration in #35713, but does not address flaky tests or missing coverage.
